name: Siyadieh Express

components.name: Siyadieh Express
steps: Defrost the fish fillets overnight in the fridge, or for about 1 hour in cold water in a sealed bag. Pat dry — the fish releases a lot of water as it thaws.
Thinly slice the onions and caramelize slowly in olive oil until deep golden brown — this is the base of the dish's flavor.
Season the fish fillets with salt, pepper, and half the spice mix, then bake at 200°C for 12-15 minutes until just cooked.
Meanwhile, cook the basmati rice with the remaining spices and a portion of the caramelized onions stirred through.
Layer the spiced rice on a platter, top with the flaked fish and remaining caramelized onions.

notes: Needs Mirna review — for now this dish scales as a whole (portion sizes only), never by component or ingredient.

flags.shelfLife: Fish — once thawed, cook within 1-2 days. Do not leave this one to day 5.
